questions.prompt: A 4 × 4 × 4 cube is painted on all six faces and then cut into 64 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly two painted faces?
questions.solution: Only cubes along the edges have exactly two painted faces. There are 12 edges, and each edge has 4 − 2 = 2 such cubes after removing the corners. 12 × 2 = 24.

questions.prompt: How many rectangles of any size can be formed by the grid lines of a 5-column × 4-row grid?
questions.solution: A rectangle is chosen by picking 2 of the 6 vertical lines and 2 of the 5 horizontal lines. C(6,2) × C(5,2) = 15 × 10 = 150.

questions.prompt: A 6 cm cube is painted on all faces and cut into 2 cm cubes. How many of the resulting cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.solution: The cube becomes 3 × 3 × 3. On each face, only the centre cube has exactly one painted face. There are 6 faces, so 6 cubes.

questions.prompt: A 3 × 3 × 3 cube is painted on all faces and cut into 27 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
questions.solution: Only the single cube at the centre is completely hidden from all six faces. Answer: 1.

questions.prompt: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
questions.solution: A triangular prism has 2 triangular ends and 3 rectangular sides, so 5 faces.
